scope: Canonical scientific and AI terms explicitly discussed across the eight UNLOCK 2026 transcripts. Company and person names remain in the conference graph; named models, benchmarks, and platforms are included here when they carry technical meaning; a block of popular LLM providers (under 'AI and machine learning') and their current model names (under 'Named model or benchmark') was added 2026-08-26 to support AI-domain transcript correction.

terms.definition: A strategy in which a model selects the most informative next examples or experiments from which to learn.
